The '''Nicandra system''' was located in the [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Ilimardon system/Legends|Ilimardon system]] as well as the [[Ylix system/Legends|Ylix system]] in the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]] and the [[Mapuzo system/Legends|Mapuzo]] and [[Tartaglia system/Legends|Tartaglia systems]] of the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The Nicandra [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Nicandra Plaza]] and the [[Nicandra Counterrevolutionary Signalmen's Memorial Building/Legends|Nicandra Counterrevolutionary Signalmen's Memorial Building]], both located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Labyrinth">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the New Republic dispatched the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|fleet carrier]] [[Endurance (Endurance-class)|''Endurance'']] to [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|fight]] against the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. To that end, the ''Endurance'' traveled from the Mapuzo system to the Ilimardon system, passing through the Nicandra system in the process.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nicandra system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA" />
